label: def:observable-subcategory
title: Observable subcategory $\mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}(\mathbb{P}(V))$
html:
Let \mathrm{Bun}(\mathbb{P}(V)) be the category of finite bundles over the projective line and its morphisms are permutation-isotopy pairs.

The observable subcategory \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}(\mathbb{P}(V)) is the full subcategory on objects where the degree-0 algebra is non-trivial:

  \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}(\mathbb{P}(V)) = \bigl\{ \mathcal{S} \in \mathrm{Bun}(\mathbb{P}(V)) : \Gamma(\mathcal{S}, A_0) \neq 0 \bigr\}.

Observability. We require a non-degenerate Frobenius pairing to define degree-0 measurements . When A_0|_{\mathcal{S}} = 0, the pairing degenerates on the lowest floor of the brane tower and no degree-0 observable is well-defined. The subcategory \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ} defines the regime where the full observational apparatus functions.

Complement. The complement \mathrm{Bun}(\mathbb{P}(V)) \setminus \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}(\mathbb{P}(V)) consists of configurations with A_0 = 0. These are the jet horizons and big bang states .

Connected components. The connected components \pi_0(\mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}) are the aeons . Each aeon is a maximal connected full subcategory of \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}. It encompasses all light cones accessible without crossing a jet horizon.
